question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**primary**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**primary**" means most important or chief. It fits the context because nicotine is the main or primary addictive component of tobacco smoke.
 
• The other options: "**secondary**," "**minor**," and "**trivial**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Nicotine is the primary__ addictive component of tobacco smoke.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Secondary (द्वितीय)**: means less important than primary; following or coming after the primary one.
 
• **Minor (अल्प)**: means less important or smaller in size/amount.
 
• **Trivial (तुच्छ)**: means of little value or importance.
